Threads panel and PDF section: mock-up

DFMA Review · Inventor I1, slice S2 · 2026-11-08 · before any screen code

Proposal: a fold-away "Threads" panel under Findings, open when the .ipt has threads, plus a Threads section on the PDF's first page. One row per thread: its state (matched, disagrees or not mapped), the callout (e.g. M12x1.75 - 6H), its hole, the depth and the tap drill. Tapping a row shows its hole on the model. A thread that disagrees is also a finding, so it can't be missed.

Your answer: Approve · Change (say what) · Rethink.

1. NIST CTC 04 with its .ipt: 4 threads, all matched

2. NIST STC 10: one thread disagrees

3. All three states, and the 900 px width

Other states

CaseWhat shows
Only a STEP fileNo Threads panel, exactly as today.
An .ipt with no threadsThe panel, folded, with count 0; opened it reads "No threads in this .ipt."
Tap a thread rowIts row gets the blue outline and its hole's faces turn blue in the 3D view, as a Passed row does. A not-mapped row has no hole, so nothing is selected.
The hole itselfIts row in the Passed list, and any finding on it, gains "Thread: M12x1.75 - 6H (from the .ipt)".

What doesn't change

  • In the app a NIST pair is still refused ("These files don't match …"). The pictures above use the test harness, which lines NIST's files up first; the demo will say so.
